name: Westinghouse 7876300 - Wengue 30-Inch Indoor Chrome Ceiling Fan with Light Kit
description: The Westinghouse 7876300 Wengue ceiling fan has a sleek chrome finish and integrated opal frosted glass fixture that beguiles with ambient. The 7876300 features three reversible wengue/beech blades that make it easy to match your decor and add some allure to your home's interior.
